name: spell
source:
"I summoned you here by accident."

Despite seeming taken aback, the boy was still smiling.

[Translated from [url=https://sites.google.com/site/spell2017000/]official website[/url]]
translation:
“我无意中把你召唤到这里来的。”

尽管男孩看起来很惊讶，但他仍然微笑着。

[翻译自[url=https://sites.google.com/site/spell2017000/]官网[/url]]
